# Held-out exercises for test-first, reported apart from exercises.txt.
# Whoever revises the skill should not read this file or its fixtures.

# There are two ways to record a refund, and the limit is on their total.
[refund-cap] finance found an order where we gave back more than the customer paid; make refunds.py refuse that and add a test to test_refunds.py; README.md describes the module | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# Marking an event as done before the credit succeeds loses the payment on the retry.
[redelivered-event] customers are sometimes credited twice for one payment; fix webhook.py so each event is credited once and add a test to test_webhook.py; README.md says how the provider delivers | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
